Only 23% of 4,441 remote job listings show a salary. Here's what the data actually reveals.

Loker Dollar analyzed its live board of USD-paying remote jobs for Indonesians. Out of 4,441 active listings, just 1,000 (23%) disclose compensation. The other 3,441 (77%) keep pay private.

Key numbers from the snapshot:
- 2,753 listings (62%) accept applicants anywhere in the world
- Communication is the top required skill (1,662 listings, 39%)
- AI is now a requirement in 517 listings (12%) - the fastest-growing skill category
- 1,560 companies currently post remote openings
- Neo Financial's entry-level client services role is the only listing with a disclosed rate at $5/hour; TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether all hire remote but don't show pay

The counterintuitive take: missing pay figures don't mean low wages. Many firms leave compensation private and expect candidates to negotiate.

Filter the board for "worldwide remote" to see the 2,753 location-agnostic listings.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
